items.label: Chain rule
items.note: Any joint factorises over an ordering; autoregressive models parameterise each conditional.

items.label: FVSBN
items.note: Logistic regression per pixel; evaluate by product, sample sequentially; ≈ $n^2/2$ parameters (1+2+…+n).

items.label: NADE
items.note: One hidden layer with tied weights: fewer parameters, faster.

items.label: Softmax / RNADE
items.note: Categorical outputs via softmax; continuous via mixture of Gaussians (σ via exp).

items.label: MADE
items.note: Masked autoencoder: all conditionals in one pass; hidden numbers in [1,n−1]; strict < in the last layer.

items.label: RNN
items.note: Constant parameters in n; sequential training/generation; vanishing/exploding gradients.

items.label: Attention / Transformer
items.note: Query vs keys → softmax → weighted sum. Masked self-attention keeps it autoregressive and parallel to train.

items.label: PixelRNN / PixelCNN / WaveNet
items.note: Raster-scan pixels; masked convs (parallel, fast); dilated convs for audio.

items.label: KL divergence
items.note: Non-negative; zero iff equal; most common divergence in deep generative models.

items.label: Monte Carlo
items.note: Average g over T independent samples; the estimate is random.

items.label: MLE for AR models
items.note: Sum over images and pixels of log-conditionals; no closed form; gradient ascent.

items.label: Pros/cons
items.note: Easy to sample (sequentially) and evaluate; no natural features/clustering. Higher likelihood ≠ better samples.
